definition: The Innovation Center for Artificial Intelligence (ICAI) is a Dutch national network focused on joint technology development between academia, industry and government in the area of artificial intelligence (AI).
details: The initiative was launched in April 2018 and is based at Amsterdam Science Park. As of 2024, the director of the ICAI is Maarten de Rijke. In November 2018, ICAI announced its contribution to AINED, the first iteration of the Dutch National AI Strategy.

explainer.lead: ICAI is a Dutch national network for joint AI technology development between academia, industry and government. It matters as an organized channel for public-private AI collaboration, launched in April 2018 and based at Amsterdam Science Park.

tiers.eli5: Like a shared club where universities, companies and government build things together instead of separately.
tiers.practitioner: Researchers and companies join the network to co-develop AI technology; a pitfall is expecting a single lab rather than a distributed national network. Its director as of 2024 is Maarten de Rijke.
tiers.paperLevel: A Dutch national network focused on joint technology development between academia, industry and government in AI; launched April 2018, based at Amsterdam Science Park.
